customer-jordan: Hey team — after rotating keys our webhook consumer started returning 401 invalid_api_key for every request. Started around 10:12 UTC. Anyone seen this pattern?

michael: Sorry about the trouble. Can you paste the curl you used (please redact the actual key) and the exact Authorization header you’re sending?

customer-jordan: Here’s what we were running (redacted):
```
curl -X POST \"https://api.redwood.example/v1/generate\" \n  -H \"Authorization: Bearer REDACTED_KEY\" \n  -d '{"prompt":"test"}'
```
We copied the key from a file on disk and exported it in the container with `export REDWOOD_KEY='REDACTED_KEY'` so not sure.

jessica_cs: Two quick checks: 1) confirm the service is using the new key (env + restart), 2) make sure there are no extra quotes or trailing newlines in the env var. A common bad pattern: `export REDWOOD_KEY='abc123=='\n` (notice quotes + newline). The clean way: `export REDWOOD_KEY=abc123==` (no quotes, no newline).

customer-jordan: we actually did `source creds.txt` where creds.txt had the key in single quotes and the file ended with a newline. I'll try removing the quotes and re-exporting.

sre-oncall: Also I checked the org key list in the console — you have two keys: `key-2026-02-28 (disabled)` and `key-2026-03-10 (active)`. Which one did you rotate to?

customer-jordan: Using the March one (active). After re-checking raw requests I see the header was URL-encoded: `Authorization: Bearer abc123==%0A` — looks like the newline was included and got encoded. Logs still show 401 with message `invalid_api_key`.

michael: That explains it — `%0A` is a newline. Our API rejects keys containing whitespace. If the header contains a trailing newline (or wrapped in quotes/newline) it will fail parsing and return 401. Quick failing repro: 
```
# Fails (note trailing newline in header)
curl -H \"Authorization: Bearer abc123==\n\" https://api.redwood.example/v1/generate
# Successful (no newline)
curl -H \"Authorization: Bearer abc123==\" https://api.redwood.example/v1/generate
```

jessica_cs: Recovery steps we recommend: 1) sanitize your env var (no quotes, trim whitespace), 2) restart the process so env changes take effect, 3) if you think the old key was leaked during rotation, rotate and issue a fresh key and roll with two keys for zero-downtime (create new, deploy, then revoke old). We can also reissue a key for you if needed.

customer-jordan: Fixed it — removed the trailing newline and quotes, restarted the consumer, and requests are now returning 200. Appreciate the fast help :tada:

deploy-bot: deploy/webhook-consumer succeeded (build #452) :rocket:

michael: Marking this resolved and adding KB entry: "401 after key rotation often caused by trailing newline/quotes in env var or URL-encoded %0A in Authorization header" :white_check_mark:
